metadata.name: Ink Spill Theme Switch
metadata.description: A light/dark theme switch where the new theme spills out of the toggle like ink, with a ragged fractal edge, hairline tendrils and droplets. Wrap any page; no dependencies beyond React.
metadata.author: kedhareswer
